name: Fixture 2: fixed-end beams
note: do not modify without human approval
description: Issue W1-01. Spec section 5 says simply supported, which contradicts section 2.5 (all supports use one fixed condition), so this fixture holds two fixed-end cases. Each case is its own bridge, solved alone from the members of its line: line 1 is the cantilever, and line 2 is the fixed-fixed beam made of two colinear members. Both start at the origin as the issue states, so nodes 1 and 11 coincide but share no member. Positions are solver lengths in meters, and tests use scale factor 1. Section G and J are fixture-local values that keep the unused torsion blocks nonsingular; they are not game constants. Expected displacements are signed, in m; expected moments and shears are magnitudes, in N*m and N.
